title: Insurance Covenant of the Equipment & Vehicle Loans Security Agreement
content:
## Covenant in force

1. **Insurance required.** Every unit pledged to an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan must be insured against physical damage with the association named loss payee for as long as the loan is open.
2. **Proof.** Proof is recorded as received, with the expiry date and insurer exactly as printed on the certificate; a member's statement that a policy was renewed is not proof.
3. **Cure period.** Renewed proof must be received within the product's insurance lapse cure period in calendar days after the insurance expiry date on record, that date being day 0.
4. **Premium entry and its waiver.** A collateral protection premium is booked as a fee of the collateral-protection kind; when proof covering the placement date is later received, that premium is waived on the basis of error correction.
5. **Products without collateral protection.** On every other product a lapse past the cure period is a default that only a loan officer can address.

## The cure period on both sides

Hypothetical: a cure period of 15 calendar days and an insurance expiry date on record of 1 April (day 0).

| Renewed proof received | Day after the expiry date | Received within the cure period |
|---|---|---|
| 16 April | day 15 | yes |
| 17 April | day 16 | no |

## What counts as proof

| Offered | Proof |
|---|---|
| Certificate recorded with its expiry date and insurer exactly as printed | yes |
| The member's statement that the policy was renewed | no |

## Clauses no longer in force

- "When it is not, a product that places collateral protection insurance places collateral protection insurance and assesses its premium" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "the product's collateral protection annual percentage of the principal balance on the placement date for one year, rounded to cents" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The product figures named in this covenant — the insurance lapse cure period, whether the product places collateral protection and the collateral protection annual percentage — remain those of the product's insurance schedule.
